Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Datensatzklasse NpcPosition

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NpcPosition
Datensatzkomponenten:
world - the world name, never null or blank
x - the x coordinate
y - the y coordinate
z - the z coordinate
yaw - the yaw in degrees, normalised to [-180, 180)
pitch - the pitch in degrees, clamped to [-90, 90]
public record NpcPosition(String world, double x, double y, double z, float yaw, float pitch) extends Record
An immutable NPC position: the name of a world plus coordinates and a rotation.

A world name rather than a World handle is stored on purpose. NPC data is loaded before worlds are guaranteed to exist and outlives any particular world instance, so a position must stay meaningful while its world is unloaded — toLocation() then simply reports that it cannot be resolved instead of the position becoming corrupt.

Rotation is normalised on construction: yaw is wrapped into [-180, 180) and pitch is clamped to [-90, 90], which is the range the protocol can represent. Two positions that point in the same direction are therefore always equal, regardless of how the angles were expressed.

Seit:
1.0.0

      public NpcPosition(String world, double x, double y, double z, float yaw, float pitch)

      world - the world name
      x - the x coordinate
      y - the y coordinate
      z - the z coordinate
      yaw - the yaw in degrees, any value
      pitch - the pitch in degrees, any value

    • distanceSquaredTo

      public double distanceSquaredTo(NpcPosition other)
      Returns the squared distance to another position in the same world.

      Squared distance avoids a square root, which matters because visibility tracking evaluates this for every player and every NPC on every tick.

      Parameter:
      other - the position to measure to
      Gibt zurück:
      the squared distance, or Double.MAX_VALUE if the worlds differ
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if other is null

      Gibt zurück:

      Löst aus:

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Gibt an, ob ein anderes Objekt diesem gleich ("equal to") ist. Die Objekte sind gleich, wenn das andere Objekt der gleichen Klasse angehört und alle Datensatzkomponenten gleich sind. Referenzkomponenten werden verglichen mit Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive Komponenten werden verglichen mit "==".
      Angegeben von:
      equals in Klasse Record
      Parameter:
      o - das Objekt, mit dem verglichen wird
      Gibt zurück:
      true, wenn dieses Objekt gleich dem Argument o ist, andernfalls false.
